title: Study of the Psychometric Properties of Two Questionnaires for Measuring Disease Flare-up in IBD
official: Study of the Psychometric Properties of Two Questionnaires for Measuring Disease Flare-up in IBD (Crohn's Disease / Hemorrhagic Rectocolitis)
summary: Validating two questionnaires for measuring relapse in IBD (Crohn's / UC)
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patient member of the AFA Crohn RCH, and registered in the mailing list
* Person having received full information on the organization of the research and not having objected to his/her participation and to the use of his/her data.

Exclusion Criteria:

\- There were no non-inclusion criteria.
